statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended period
The service was ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes and guide further management
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was for missing prior authorization
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0
